properties.summary: Embedded malicious code in event-stream: version 3.3.6 added a dependency on flatmap-stream, which carried code targeting Copay wallet builds.
Embedded malicious code in flatmap-stream 0.1.1. Published nearly two years after the event-stream advisory, which is itself a known-time fact worth replaying.
Embedded malicious code in node-ipc: 10.1.1 and 10.1.2 overwrote files with a heart symbol on hosts whose IP geolocated to Russia or Belarus. Tracked as CVE-2022-23812.

Hidden functionality in node-ipc: version 9.2.2 depends on peacenotwar, which writes a protest file to the desktop when imported. The advisory lists 9.2.2 as the only affected version and the 9.x line has no later release, so there is no fixed version to name.
node-ipc behaviour change: 11.0.0 through 11.1.0 depend on peacenotwar, and 12.0.0 removed the dependency.
